unit: one rotation, stop, forward, stop sequence

state_fields.center_x_px: tracked slot X horizontal position, pixels
state_fields.center_y_ratio: tracked slot X vertical position / image height
state_fields.border_angle_deg: image-plane border angle; NOT metric vehicle yaw
state_fields.depth_top_y_px: top border midpoint y in pixels; not distance cm
state_fields.depth_top_y_ratio: top border midpoint y / image height
state_fields.yaw_deg: null until metric slot pose calibration is available
state_fields.depth_cm: null until slot pose calibration is available

actions: actual received cmd_vel segments, with timestamps and velocities
valid_visual_sample: same track, stationary fresh stable views at all three states
